request.subject: ICON:ACTION:WHIRL

layers.text: Redraw it as a different object in the same style: one big square soot-black riveted iron hammer head on a short bright copper arm, swinging round, with two thick curved white swoosh arcs circling round it like a spin and three small white impact stars. Nothing else: no rotor, no bomb, no face. Thick black outline, flat colours, on a transparent background.
